notes: «وَ بِهَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ» takes over the whole chain of prev1 (has_written_chain true), placed first as inherited items; the back_reference is not also written
«رَفَعَهُ إِلَی أَبِی عَبْدِ اللَّهِ» names the Imam inside the chain after «إلى»: a narrator, not imam_in_text
«(ع)» and «قَالَ:» are left out; the saying is the words after «قال» (the Imam's own words)
